description: Membership log (spec §3.5, §4). devices: secrets and records used. recovery / rotated_recovery: the owner recovery signing key before and after the personal chain's recovery_rotate. chains: verifying `events` with `options` (trusted_anchor, witnessed_checkpoint) MUST yield `expected_state` exactly (removals lists every removal with the removed sign_pub, removed_seq, the key_epoch current at removal and the signed log_fence; the recovery key may author only device_add). genesis, device_add and member_add bodies carry wraps_digest (wrap sets: device-add-wraps.json). invalid: verification MUST fail with expect_error. wrap_checks: validate `wraps` against the final state of chain `chain` (options.key_epoch null = any retained epoch 1..key_epoch); positives also give wraps_digest = b64 sha256(utf8("akv1/wraps\n") || cjson(wraps sorted by rcpt, then key_epoch)). sas: transcript, 6-digit code and digest for `input`.
